name: genesis-edd
description: Turn a feature request into a testable spec and eval packages, then implement it in a loop until its checks pass against a baseline

interface.shortDescription: Specs and evals before you build
interface.longDescription: Clarify a feature request into a spec with acceptance scenarios, turn each scenario into a Harbor eval package, compare runs before and after a change, and implement the change in a loop until the checks pass, with the user accepting the result.
defaultPrompt: Help me write the spec and acceptance scenarios for this feature.
Write evals for the exported spec.
Record the baseline, then implement the change until the evals pass.
